name: Plover River
gaugeName: PLOVER RIVER NEAR STEVENS POINT, WI
blurb: Plover River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Dam crossing/portage unresolved: Van Order, Jordan, McDill. A legal, usable route around the barrier has not been established. Do not plan this as a continuous float.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Van Order, Jordan, McDill and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.
